panels.description: Tomas leads Alex and Ada to an older service wall marked with the balanced water-drop. Keep the upper wall clear.
Tomas fits the heavy key into an unwired lock. Keep the upper lock area clear.
Tomas looks at B11 while holding the key in the lock. Keep the upper wall clear.
Alex looks back toward the active worksite as Tomas remains beside the locked door. Keep the upper worksite clear.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Adrian asked me to keep this closed.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: He said I’d know you by what you did first.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: No. Someone has to look ordinary.
